column1: # App set for the AutoRider site. Mirrors Frappe Cloud:
# Columns (TAB separated): order, app_name (python module / install-app name), repo_url, branch, access
# `frappe` comes with the bench; `erpnext` is installed by `bench new-site --install-app erpnext`.
# The Frappe Cloud site page lists repositories but NOT branches. Branches below follow the Vidira bench
# (version-16 for Frappe apps, develop for vidira_group, BT for Build-Together apps). POSNext's default branch is BT
# and its pyproject targets frappe/erpnext >=16,<17. Change a branch here if the Cloud bench uses another one.
# Install order = dependency order (hrms/india_compliance/pos_next need erpnext; vidira_group needs erpnext + india_compliance).
# Apps already cloned in ~/frappe/bt/apps (shared with other sites) are reused, not re-cloned.
